Despite launching their companies in completely different eras—one mastering live television on QVC and the other dominating TikTok—both founders share the exact same operational hurdles. description:
For New Balance and Kith founder Ronnie Fieg, business is about more than making a transaction. It’s about building with people you trust.⁣

On this week’s episode of A Different Take, Forbes’ marketing case study podcast hosted by Linda Boff, Ronnie and New Balance CMO Chris Davis discuss why working with a select group of partners who share their values has been key to building businesses that last.⁣

They unpack the difference between simply doing business together and building something for the long term.
title: Kith Founder Ronnie Fieg On Why The Best Partnerships Are Built On Trust
